title: Course Fee
description: Prints the discount band for a fee mark, with no output above 100.

data.question: Write a program that reads a mark M. Print "Discount is 200" when M is at least 90, "Discount is 100" when M is between 50 and 100, and "No Discount" when M is below 50.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: The first branch wins, so 90 through 100 print "Discount is 200". Marks above 100 match no branch.
